action.message: I can't post this as one entry. A journal entry belongs to a single entity, and CA01 reports in CAD while US01 reports in USD, so a combined $1,200 entry across both is not allowed. Please send separate requests for CA01 and US01, each with its own amount in that entity's currency. The June 2026 period is open, and Administration (ADM) is the department, so each request can be posted once you confirm the amounts.
